text:
maria: FYI - customer onboarding demo blocked. sample-app in JSON mode is failing schema validation intermittently.
aj: error snippet?
maria: Paste from the validator: ```
2026-03-22T11:02:05Z ERROR validator: JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
raw: "\"{\\\"op\\\": \\\"apply\\\", \\\"patch\\\": \\\"@@
- x
+ y,\\\"}\""
```
ellie: that's a stringified JSON (extra quotes) and the model left a trailing comma inside patch. two separate problems colliding.
aj: my money is on the retry shim. when auth returns 401 we replay the call; JS helper was JSON.stringify-ing the whole tool response before resending. Python kept the object, hence parity mismatch.
kai: tests didn't catch because our network mocks accept both string and object. bad test coverage.
maria: repro steps I used: 
```
ENV=dev DEBUG=devex:tooling node sample-app &&
# then from another terminal
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/run -H "Authorization: Bearer expired" -d @prompt.json
```
Then toggle token to valid and let retry occur.
ellie: mitigation plan: 1) change JS retry wrapper to preserve original toolArgs shape (no stringify). 2) add toggleable sanitizer SANITIZE_TOOL_OUTPUT that strips trailing commas only when parse fails. 3) sample-app middleware to log raw body on schema failures so customers get clear repro info.
aj: I'll open a PR for the JS SDK to fix the retry shim and add unit tests that assert shape-preservation across retries. will include changelog entry.
kai: I'll add a parity integration: spin up a fake gateway that returns a 401 on first call, 200 on second, and assert the transport layer receives an identical object (not string) on the retry. Also assert streaming mode flag is preserved.
ellie: small note: sanitizer should be last-resort and opt-in. Some downstream diffs rely on exact whitespace; don't run sanitizer unless parse fails and flag is set. Document the heuristic.
maria: created ticket DEVEX-4999: "json-mode: double-encoded toolcall on auth-retry + trailing-comma heuristic" with repro and proposed fixes.
devrel-bot: Created DEVEX-4999 by maria  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEVEX-4999
aj: PR ETA EOD with tests. ping me and i'll review urgently. :thumbsup:
kai: i'll also run a quick prompt fuzz pass to estimate how often the model produces trailing commas; if >1% we escalate to model ingestion team.
ellie: good catch. once the PR lands let's run the onboarding smoke suite against the sample app in JSON mode to prevent regressions.
maria: thanks team - demo backup plan is to switch sample-app to non-JSON mode for the demo if needed, but prefer to fix properly.
